name: u_robinpoly
notes: Use exactly the documented dynamic voice class and creation args8 s_drumelectro a b c d. Each bd triggers an independent real bass-drum voice via the round-robin senders. s_drumelectro has only inlet0 and outlet0, so dynamic connection to its inlet1 fails; shared inlet1 stimulation intentionally cannot affect this selected voice. Expected diagnostic: connection failed (missing s_drumelectro inlet1) and missing s_drumelectro outlet1; the wrapper right outlet must stay silent.
